description:
Cast Guilty Conscience by paying {W}, attaching it to the indestructible creature.
Cast Pain for All by paying {2}{R}, attaching it to the indestructible creature.
When Pain for All enters, it triggers, dealing damage equal to the enchanted creature's power to any target.
Guilty Conscience triggers, dealing that much damage to the creature.
Pain for All triggers, dealing that much damage to each opponent.
Repeat from step 3.
